question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id,
           c.first_name,
           c.last_name,
           date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) AS payment_month,
           SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_amount
    FROM payment p
    JOIN top10 t ON p.customer_id = t.customer_id
    JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, payment_month, monthly_amount,
           LAG(monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) AS prev_month_amount
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, payment_month, monthly_amount, prev_month_amount,
       ROUND(monthly_amount - prev_month_amount, 2) AS month_over_month_diff
FROM with_lag
WHERE prev_month_amount IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month_over_month_diff DESC
LIMIT 1
